title: Petition of Marathon Lines, Inc. for a 120-day temporary license, under the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws, Chapter 159A, Section 5, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the Towns of Framingham, Brookline and the City of Boston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority, restricted to students, faculty, personnel, and employees of Boston University and the University hospitals.
